Title: Azure Log Analytics is available in West US 2

Body.Content: Azure Log Analytics is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data. Log Analytics is now available and can be built in West US 2.
